entities.text: High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. The present Revision Application is filed against the judgment and order dated 19.03.2016 rendered by the learned Principal District Judge, Navsari in Criminal Appeal No.2 of 2006,
whereby, the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate in Criminal Case No.923 of 1999 has been ordered to be confirmed.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the present Criminal Revision Application deserves consideration mainly on the ground that there is a marginal difference from the permissible limit and second; there is a clear violation of Rule 14 as well as non compliance of Rule 12 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules read with Section 14A of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

3. Upon hearing the learned counsel for the applicant, NOTICE is issued upon respondent,
returnable on 26.04.2016.
Learned APP Mr.R.C.Kodekar waives service of notice on behalf of respondent No.2.
Interim relief in terms of paragraph No.12C is granted till the returnable date.
